subtopic_transcripts.subtopic_title: EduRot: The Art of Automated Brain Rot

dialogue.caption: Stewie, our 'EduRot' app is brilliant! I always knew my stupid ideas would change the world!
dialogue.speaker: PETER

dialogue.caption: It’s a magnificent AI orchestration, Father. We extract facts and then clone your nasally, yet surprisingly valuable, voice.
dialogue.speaker: STEWIE

dialogue.caption: So a user just types 'Explain gravity,' and the app mixes my voice with addictive parkour footage?
dialogue.speaker: PETER

dialogue.caption: Yes! The video is assembled automatically, forcing the viewer to watch through sheer, chaotic obligation. It's genius!
dialogue.speaker: STEWIE

dialogue.caption: Does the app also automatically give me a massive headache like real scrolling does? That's realism!
dialogue.speaker: PETER

dialogue.caption: No, you pea-brain! It adds huge captions and visuals. We programmed it for peak virality, not migraines!
dialogue.speaker: STEWIE

dialogue.caption: Ha! I knew combining learning and utter chaos would be the future of my internet domination!
dialogue.speaker: PETER
